annotations.title: Correlation matrix + diversification: Pearson/Spearman of returns, CIs, portfolio risk

description: Correlation matrix + diversification: Pearson/Spearman of returns, CIs, portfolio risk — Offline correlation analysis for 2-20 assets. series= (required) NAME:v1,v2,...;NAME2:... oldest first (series of unequal length are aligned on their most recent values). type=prices (default, converted to period returns) or returns; method=pearson (default) or spearman; weights=NAME:pct,... or pct,pct (default equal); period=daily|weekly|monthly|crypto to annualize volatility. Returns the correlation matrix, every pair with 95% Fisher-z CI, significance and strength label, most/least correlated pair, average correlation, portfolio volatility, diversification ratio with verdict WELL_DIVERSIFIED/SOME_DIVERSIFICATION/CONCENTRATED_RISK, and each asset's volatility and risk contribution %. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_correlation
